ideas.pitch: A multi-agent system where specialized AI agents manage campus facility bookings, IT help desk ticketing, and event scheduling autonomously.
ideas.title: MultiAgent-CampusOps
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an administrative pain point familiar to student and university judges alike, utilizing a collaborative multi-agent architecture emphasized in the event overview.

ideas.pitch: A BPMN-orchestrated multi-agent governance platform that diagnoses pre-deployment risks in automated workflows with human-in-the-loop validation.
ideas.title: AgentFlow-BPMN
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates enterprise-grade AI governance and structured workflow planning, a high-value technical angle for judging panels.

ideas.pitch: An engineering team lifecycle intelligence agent that captures codebase tribal knowledge from git history and PRs, answering queries when new developers join.
ideas.title: DevKnowledge-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets a developer pain point with a working knowledge-management system, echoing successful engineering tool hacks.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first autonomous agent that analyzes incoming communication streams in real-time to protect elderly users from sophisticated social engineering and email scams.
ideas.title: ScamGuard-VoiceAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-impact consumer protection with a live, demonstrable voice interface that captures judges' attention.

ideas.pitch: An AI-enhanced lost-and-found portal featuring multimodal item matching via vision models and real-time geolocation mapping for recovered campus items.
ideas.title: CampusFind-Multimodal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an extremely reliable, easy-to-demo product with immediate utility for university students.
